jsonld_raw.name: (480 ML) PUMPKIN SPICE HAND SOAP
jsonld_raw.description:
Perfumed hand soap. Presented in a solid-color cylindrical bottle with embossed vertical stripes and a dispenser cap.

Pumpkin Spice | An invitation to your deepest memories. Warm and surprising spices that reveal a delicious sweet pumpkin accord intertwined with creamy notes of sandalwood and cashmere.

Notes:
Top notes: Citrus, nutmeg.
Heart notes: Pumpkin.
Base notes: Cinnamon, spices, cashmeran, dry wood.
